name: Together AI
short: Together's serverless inference, provisioned capacity and dedicated GPUs for open models — one API over Kimi, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM and more.

plans.name: Serverless Inference
plans.notes: Per-model rates with cached-input discounts; Qwen3.8 Max $2.00/$6.00, DeepSeek V4 Pro $1.32/$3.96.

plans.name: Provisioned Throughput
plans.notes: Reserve fixed capacity in throughput units; delivered tokens-per-minute depends on the model and token type.

plans.name: Dedicated Inference
plans.notes: Single-tenant on-demand endpoints; B200 $8.99/GPU-hour, reserved capacity via sales.

plans.name: Fine-Tuning
plans.notes: LoRA or full supervised fine-tuning and DPO; $4 minimum charge on small models.
